faq.question: What is a submission code?
faq.answer: A 13-digit code from school, e.g. 0990500100001 (campaign + month + school + sequence).

faq.question: Do I need a coupon?
faq.answer: In-school students use the school sponsor coupon for free. Others pay RM 15.
